services.name: Kid's Waterski Clinics
services.desc: Learn to Waterski! Duration Two 3 hour sessions (Monday - Tuesday) Starts at 9:30am each day. About We welcome children ages 8-14 to join us on the water to focus on waterskiing with our highly qualified captains and crew members! Clinics focus on learning to get up on two skis, crossing the wakes and progressing to learning to slalom ski and cross the wakes. All ability levels are welcomed as our crew can customize instruction based on individual skill and comfort levels. No experience necessary. services.name: Kid's Wakeboard Clinics
services.desc: Learn to Wakeboard! Duration Two 3 hour sessions (Wednesday & Thursday) Starts at 9:30am each day. About We welcome children ages 8-14 to join us on the water to focus on wakeboarding with our highly qualified captains and crew members! Clinics focus on learning to wakeboard, edge control, and progressing to jumping the wakes. All ability levels are welcomed as our crew can customize instruction based on individual skill and comfort levels. No experience necessary.
